text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option A 18.0 to 18.8 s. The white car moves slowly rightward along the flooded street while the brown water line rises over its wheels; by 18.6 s the lower half of the wheels is under water. Houses and a live oak behind. The car sits in the band just above the caption box.
